test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

They __wondered about in__ sheepskins and goatskins in those days.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• The verb **"wandered" **indicates a continuous action in the past.
 
• The preposition** "about" **suggests movement around or through an area.
 
• The preposition **"in" **indicates the clothing they were wearing.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is** 'Option 1.'**

Therefore, the correct sentence is 'They** wandered about in__** sheepskins and goatskins in those days.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option (2) - "wandered in" ** misses the aspect of moving around. "Wandered in" suggests entering a place, not moving throughout an area.
 
• **Option (3) - "wander about in" ** has a grammatical error. The verb needs to be in the past tense to match "those days".
 
• **Option (4) - "wondered in" ** uses the wrong verb. "Wonder" suggests curiosity or doubt, not physical movement.
